Hi Elaine,

Great to speak this morning — thanks for the time. Per our call, I sketched a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that aligns milestones across both teams and surfaces the key dependencies we discussed (procurement, network access, and initial model tuning).

High level proposal:
- Week 0 (Sept 21): Kickoff + environment checks (VPN, IP allowlist, initial credentials)
- Weeks 1–2: Base integration + ingestion connector (Sunrise devs + Redwood integration engineer)
- Weeks 3–4: Model tuning and test prompts; acceptance criteria defined by Sunrise QA lead
- Week 5: Cutover rehearsal and rollback plan; dry run with simulated traffic
- Week 6: Go-live + 30-day stabilization window

Deliverables we will provide: MAP spreadsheet (attached), SOW draft, kickoff agenda.

Could you confirm a kickoff slot for Tuesday, Sept 21 between 10–11am PT? Also looping in Ben and Monica here to ensure we have CS and Implementation coverage on day one.

Attachments: Sunrise_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_Sunrise_v2.docx

Thanks,
